description: Move actor memory, relationship updates, friend-reference updates, and conversation memory out of InteractionLedger into focused owners. Leave one small cycle recorder to coordinate a completed decision across those owners. Preserve contact counts, opt-out state, welcome state, follow state, conversation turns, unanswered-follow-up tracking, and the order of durable updates. Acceptance: InteractionLedger is removed or reduced to a clear compatibility facade; actor, relationship, conversation, and cycle-recording tests cover success, retry, and already-terminal events.
title: Separate actor and conversation memory ownership
